reviewer: Codex: five-language first-use planning material and actual native contract review
review_scope: Read every localized lesson outline and the fictional assignment, customer/operating notes, revised assignment and vehicle update. Read all ten delivered readable plans and reviewed their source statements, constraints and changed objectives against those inputs. Verified all local source, canonical contract, validation and review-note links. The current native packager checks the actual contracts and exact source anchors. All 25 advisory regression cases pass; ten distinct planner cases bind this kit and its five languages. Each practice retains the initial plan and creates a separate revised plan. These are Markdown and JSON material checks, not proof of live voice, learner understanding, native GUI presentation or professional approval. The authored regression interpretations are outside the shipped kits. Native course-chat runtime review: unchanged authored lesson text, inputs, expectations and editorial judgments; new UI handoff validated by 39 focused tests. Host-native acceptance remains separate.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: The plain title teaches asking Clara to define an advisory assignment: decision, reader, intended output, sources, limits and next work. The guide starts from a natural request and finishes with a plan and handoff, not an already executed recommendation. It explains what the next supported Clara workflow will receive.
editorial.inputs_and_request: The fictional bicycle shop asks to compare a small appointment-based collection pilot and an immediate daily service. Two initial documents distinguish conditional customer interest from bookings and describe Wednesday vehicle availability, the owner handling initial deliveries and no dedicated daily driver. The request excludes external research, contact, spending and an invented forecast. Original and revised source documents remain directly linked.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: Native packaging validates the authored contract and exact source anchors. The human-readable delivery explains the same assignment in the selected language. Checkpoints ask the learner to identify decision and audience, review scope and gaps, and explain the next output before handoff. Canonical identifiers and statuses remain technical fields; no classification code selects the assignment meaning.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: The current 280–369 word readable plans state the decision, requested output, attributed source evidence, included/excluded work, three steps, open information needs and next action. The contract selects clara:advisory-case-director. Passing local validation is distinguished from completing the subsequent advice or approving launch. All linked sources, contract, validation report and review note exist locally.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: The practice first runs the original plan, then packages a new plan from the revised request and vehicle update. It changes the deliverable to a feasibility action list, prioritizes resolving vehicle availability and does not recommend launch or assume a loan is agreed. Initial plan bytes remain unchanged and a direct link reopens it. The lesson explains how to repeat with a new decision, reader, desired output and selected evidence.
editorial.language_and_pacing: Language it. The whole outline, original fictional notes, generated assignment semantics, readable plan and review note were reviewed in this language. Six stages total 390 seconds; the concise output supports guided reading and practice within the requested range, with questions and processing allowed to extend elapsed time. No human timing or comprehension result is claimed.

demo.result_review: The actual native contract binds two exact source files and eight material source paragraphs, keeps the owner as audience, excludes unsupported financial forecasts and external actions, and defines the requested comparison memo for the next workflow. The readable plan explains the source basis, work and missing prerequisites.

practice.result_review: The revised native contract binds four exact source files and eleven source paragraphs. The new objective and action-list deliverable replace the initial recommendation request. The latest vehicle note is controlling and the proposed loan is not assumed available. The initial completed plan remains byte-identical; the new readable plan links it and explains the change.
